annotations.title: Evaluate an x402 payment (read-only, never signs)

description: Call this BEFORE signing any x402 payment. Verdict is pay | review | do_not_pay, each with stable reason codes (e.g. 'amount 1.00 USDC exceeds max_amount 0.05 USDC'). Returns the decision plus a signed receipt you can verify offline with verify_receipt. Read-only: holds no keys, never signs, never moves funds. A refusal costs nothing.

agent_id.description: Which agent is asking. Required to reach per-agent budgets in policy.agents.

name: evaluate_mcp_payment
